newsitem.title: FRANCE: New Accor head to be named later in Oct.
newsitem.headline: New Accor head to be named later in Oct.

text.p: The co-chairmen of Accor, Paul Dubrule et Gerard Pelisson, said in a statement on Tuesday they would announce a new chief executive in the second half of October.

"Paul Dubrulle and Gerard Pelisson confirm they will propose in the second half of October to the board of Accor and later to the shareholders' annual meeting the transformation of Accor into a public limited company," they said in a statement.
"At this time, they will also make known their choice as to the identity of the future head of the board of directors," they said.

Accor shares closed up 2.82 percent at 656 francs on Tuesday following press reports Jean-Marc Espalioux, currently assisting managing director of Cie Generale des Eaux, might be chosen as a possible chairman of the board.
The change in the group's structure had been announced at the company's last annual general meeting.
Dubrule and Pelisson are expected to become co-chairmen of the supervisory board of the new structure.
